description: Return meeting readings across all cities, optionally filtered by date range or jurisdiction substring. Same response shape as meeting_index but with no required parameters. Call with no args to get the full corpus, or pass a jurisdiction substring (e.g., "minneola") to filter by city without requiring an exact match. Use when you need to enumerate the full meeting record or scan across cities by date range.

from_date.description: Inclusive lower bound (ISO 8601 date). Omit to span back to the earliest reading.

jurisdiction.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to filter by city (e.g., "minneola"). Omit for all cities.

to_date.description: Inclusive upper bound (ISO 8601 date). Omit for the latest reading.

name: list_meetings
title: List Meetings
